scripts.relink:plugin: sh scripts/with-plugin-env.sh sh -c 'streamdeck unlink "$PLUGIN_UUID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; streamdeck link "$PLUGIN_DIR"'
scripts.install:plugin: npm run build && npm run validate && npm run relink:plugin && npm run restart
scripts.dist: npm run build && sh scripts/with-plugin-env.sh sh -c 'mkdir -p "$DIST_DIR" && streamdeck pack "$PLUGIN_DIR" --output "$DIST_DIR" --force'
